tools.name: generate_routes
tools.description: Use this when someone wants a cycling (road or gravel), running, trail running, walking or hiking route that starts and finishes at the same place, with a target distance or duration and optional climbing, scenery, style and route preferences, or a trip from a start to a destination, split into days

tools.name: find_place
tools.description: Look up a place by name or address and return matching places with their coordinates. Use it to confirm an ambiguous start before generating routes.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "generate_routes" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Use this when someone wants a cycling (road or gravel), running, trail running, walking or hiking route that starts and finishes at the same place, with a targe…

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "generate_routes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use this when someone wants a cycling, running or walking route that starts and finishes at the same place, with a target distance or duration and optional climbing and scenery preferences, or a trip from a start to a destination, split into days (give destination, or dest_lng and dest_lat; distance" → after: "Use this when someone wants a cycling (road or gravel), running, trail running, walking or hiking route that starts and finishes at the same place, with a target distance or duration and optional climbing, scenery, style and route preferences, or a trip from a start to a destination, split into days"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
